label: The mirror image of the actual world satisfies every ESSENCE_5 truth the actual world does
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: orientation-free natures, at w only. For every being x and world-proposition φ, if it lies in the nature of x that φ and φ holds at w, then φ holds at the mirror image σ w. No nature contains a condition that the actual arrangement meets and its mirror image violates. Under essence grounding necessity at w, world-level essence-grounded possibility and factivity it is equivalent to the accessibility of σ w (Lean-only pres_iff_mirrorPossible, certificate clause 9), so its warrant is exactly the warrant for 'the mirror world is possible'. With σ the plain spatial reflection P it is doubtful on dispositional essentialism: the weak interaction is not reflection-invariant (physics background, navigation only), so the P-image of the actual world violates law-grounding natures of creaturely kinds, which is option 1 at a creature. With σ read as CPT conjugation, under which local Lorentz-invariant quantum field theory is invariant, creaturely law-natures give no such violation. A nature containing a primitive orientation, or an essential truth about which of two incongruent counterparts is realized, denies it. It says nothing about natures at other worlds.
